name: Cala Countertop Basin 450
blurb: A softly squared 450 mm bowl in matte vitreous china, sized for compact counters.
description:
Cala is the gentlest family in our range — a thick-walled bowl with a 60 mm outer radius and an interior that falls away smoothly to a concealed waste. It sits low on the counter, so the profile reads as one continuous curve rather than a placed object.

Each piece is slip-cast, glazed inside and out and fired at 1,220 °C. The matte exterior is hand-finished after firing while the interior stays gloss for easy cleaning. Pair it with any tall or wall-mounted mixer from the Rivo line.

name: Linea Vessel Basin 600
blurb: A wide 600 mm vessel with our thinnest rim — 35 mm of glazed ceramic at the lip.
description:
Linea is drawn as a single straight line extruded into a basin. The rim is the most demanding part: at 35 mm it is far thinner than conventional casting allows, so these bowls are high-pressure cast and trimmed by hand before glazing.

The result is a long, low vessel suited to double-counter installations and generous single vanities. The interior holds a deep gloss glaze fired to 1,220 °C, warrantied for ten years against crazing and staining.

name: Arco Wall-Hung Basin 550
blurb: A 550 mm wall-hung slab with a concealed steel bracket and an integrated tap deck.
description:
Arco hangs 40 mm off the wall with a continuous shadow gap, so the basin reads as a floating slab rather than a hung fixture. The steel bracket is fully concealed and rated to 200 kg — well beyond any load a bathroom sees.

The integrated deck takes a single-hole mixer, and the underside is glazed to the wall so the piece is finished from every angle. The bracket, fixings and a template are included in the box.

name: Pietra Honed Stone Basin 500
blurb: A vessel carved from a single block of honed travertine, sealed for daily use.
description:
Each Pietra basin is cut and honed from one block of Classico travertine, so no two pieces carry the same veining. The exterior is left with a fine honed texture; the bowl is honed smoother and sealed with an impregnating sealer.

Stone asks a little more of its owner than ceramic: we recommend resealing once a year, and we supply the first bottle of sealer with the basin. It rewards the care — the surface deepens in tone quietly over the years.

name: Arco Wall-Hung WC, Rimless
blurb: A rimless wall-hung pan with a 3/4.5 L dual flush and a quick-release soft-close seat.
description:
The Arco pan is rimless: one smooth channel guides the flush around the entire bowl, so there is nowhere for scale or residue to hide. Flush volume is 3 or 4.5 litres on a dual plate, quiet enough for a bathroom adjacent to a bedroom.

The pan mounts to our concealed frame (SW-FR-01, sold separately) with a 400 kg load rating. The included seat is soft-close and lifts off with one button for cleaning around the hinges.

name: Linea Back-to-Wall WC
blurb: A back-to-wall pan with a clean floor line and a concealed S-trap outlet.
description:
Linea sits flush to the floor and the wall, with every pipe and fitting hidden inside the body. The rimless bowl and glazed trapway are built to the same specification as our wall-hung pans, for projects where a concealed frame is not practical.

The dual flush runs 3/4.5 litres and the quick-release seat is shared across the range, so a replacement — should you ever need one — is a stock item, not an order.

name: Cala Close-Coupled WC
blurb: A rounded close-coupled suite with a rimless bowl and quiet 3/4.5 L flush.
description:
The traditional suite, made properly. Cala's cistern and pan are moulded as a matched pair, so the joint line between them is nearly invisible — a small thing that changes the whole read of the piece.

Inside, the mechanism is a cable-operated dual flush with a fully glazed trapway and rimless bowl. It installs to a standard S-trap floor outlet and suits the majority of Indian bathrooms without alteration.

name: Rivo Single-Lever Basin Mixer
blurb: Our standard mixer — solid brass body, 35 mm ceramic cartridge, brushed nickel.
description:
Rivo is the mixer we build everything else against. The body is cast CW617N brass, machined on a five-axis centre, and the lever moves on a 35 mm ceramic disc cartridge rated for 500,000 cycles — roughly forty years of an average household.

Flow is limited to 5.7 L/min through an aerated stream that feels fuller than the number suggests. The brushed nickel finish is PVD-bonded rather than electroplated, so it will not peel or cloud; it carries its own five-year warranty.

name: Rivo Tall Basin Mixer
blurb: The tall Rivo, raised to 285 mm to clear vessel and countertop basins.
description:
The Tall Rivo shares its valve, aerator and internals with the standard mixer, raised on a longer body to clear a 150 mm vessel with room to spare. The lever action stays light — the extra height does not change the cartridge geometry.

It is the natural partner for our Cala and Pietra countertop bowls. Supplied with 450 mm braided flexi-hoses and a single-hole Ø 35 mm deck fixing.

name: Arco Wall-Mounted Spout & Mixer
blurb: A wall-mounted spout and single-lever control set, for counters that stay clear.
description:
Arco moves the tap off the counter entirely. The spout and the single-lever control mount independently on the wall — left, right or above-centre of the basin — so the layout follows the architecture rather than the plumbing.

The concealed rough-in body is included, with a plaster guard and service access from the front. Spout reach is 200 mm; the cartridge is the same 35 mm ceramic unit used across the range.

name: Linea Basin Mixer
blurb: A slim single-hole mixer in polished chrome — the quiet workhorse.
description:
Linea is the least expensive mixer we make and the one we are most particular about. At this price the temptation is zinc; we stayed with brass, kept the same ceramic cartridge as the Rivo, and spent the savings on more polishing time.

The result is a slim, single-hole mixer with a mirror chrome finish, aerated 5 L/min flow and the same warranty terms as the rest of the line.

name: Onda Ceiling Rain Shower 300
blurb: A 300 mm square rain head in 304 stainless, just 8 mm thin, ceiling-mounted.
description:
Onda is a single sheet of 304 stainless, laser-welded and ground until the head is 8 mm edge to edge. Its 196 nozzles are angled minutely outward, so the spray pattern lands as a full rectangle rather than a cone that misses your shoulders.

Each nozzle is soft silicone — limescale rubs away with a thumb. The head performs down to 1.0 bar, suits pressurised and most gravity-fed Indian systems, and ships with a ceiling arm adjustable between 150 and 450 mm.

name: Onda Shower Column, Thermostatic
blurb: An exposed thermostatic column — overhead, hand shower and diverter on one rail.
description:
The column combines a 250 mm overhead rain head, a three-mode hand shower and a Vernet thermostatic cartridge with a 38 °C safety stop, in a single exposed rail that fixes to finished walls — no re-tiling, no chasing.

The rail telescopes between 900 and 1,250 mm to suit existing outlet heights, and the three-way diverter runs overhead, hand shower or both together where pressure allows.

name: Rivo Hand Shower Set
blurb: A three-mode hand shower on a 700 mm rail with a 1.5 m braided hose.
description:
A proper hand shower set rather than an accessory: a three-mode head (rain, massage, mixed) on a smoothly adjustable riser rail, with a 1.5 m double-lock braided hose that will not kink or stain.

The slider moves one-handed and locks with a quarter turn. All nozzles are rub-clean silicone, and the set fits standard ½" outlets.

name: Onda Round Rain Shower 250
blurb: The round Onda — 250 mm across, wall or ceiling arm, brushed steel.
description:
The round Onda carries the same laser-welded 8 mm construction as its square sibling, sized for smaller enclosures. One hundred and forty-two nozzles, a full-circle spray and the same rub-clean silicone tips.

Order it with a wall arm or ceiling arm at no difference in price — the head is supplied with a universal ball joint that takes either.
installation: Wall or ceiling arm, universal joint

name: Cala Freestanding Bath 1700
blurb: A one-piece mineral composite bath with a warm, matte hand-feel.
description:
Cala is cast — not laminated — from mineral composite, so the colour runs through the full 25 mm wall. Scratches sand out; the surface never delaminates, chips or yellows. The matte finish has a warm, dry hand-feel that acrylic does not approach.

The double wall insulates well enough to hold bath temperature for close to an hour. It stands 1,700 mm long, holds 320 litres, weighs 190 kg empty and installs on a floor waste with the included trap.

name: Linea Freestanding Bath 1600
blurb: A compact double-walled acrylic bath at 1,600 mm, for tighter rooms.
description:
Linea brings the freestanding silhouette into bathrooms that cannot take 1,700 mm. Two acrylic shells are bonded with a reinforcing core between them, which stiffens the rim and keeps the water warm without the weight of solid surface.

At 48 kg it can be carried by two people and stood on any level floor. Supplied with a pop-up waste and overflow in chrome; PVD finishes on request.

name: Studio Oak Vanity 1200
blurb: A wall-hung oak console with two soft-close drawers and an inset ceramic top.
description:
Studio is built as furniture, not cabinetry: solid oak frames, dovetail drawers and an oiled finish that can be refreshed rather than replaced. The two drawers run on concealed soft-close runners and are U-shaped around the trap, so plumbing never wastes a drawer.

The inset top is our own gloss ceramic with a slim 12 mm edge, sized for a single centred basin. Chrome drawer pulls are standard; unlacquered brass on request.
finish: Natural oiled oak · gloss white top

name: Rivo Floor-Standing Bath Filler
blurb: A floor-standing filler with a hand shower — solid brass, 980 mm tall.
description:
The Rivo bath filler stands independent of the bath, anchored to a brass rough-in that is cast into the floor screed. One lever controls flow and temperature; a button diverts to the hand shower for rinsing the tub — and the dog.

Flow is 22 L/min at 3 bar, so a 320 litre bath fills in about eight minutes. The brushed nickel PVD finish carries the same five-year finish warranty as the rest of the Rivo line.

name: Studio Fireclay Belfast Sink 600
blurb: A glazed fireclay farmhouse sink with a 250 mm deep bowl and apron front.
description:
Fireclay is the original farmhouse material and still the best for a working sink: moulded clay glazed and fired at 1,200 °C until the glaze fuses with the body. It shrugs off pans, bleach and decades of abuse.

The apron is reversible — fluted on one face, plain on the other — so the look can change with a kitchen refit without changing the sink. Sized for a standard 600 mm cabinet, 250 mm deep, 38 kg.

name: Studio Pull-Out Kitchen Mixer
blurb: A pull-out spray mixer with a 420 mm arch and a dual-spray head.
description:
The Studio mixer arches high enough to fill a stock pot, then pulls out on a 500 mm braided hose to rinse the far corners of the bowl. The head switches between an aerated stream and a wide spray with one thumb button.

A magnetic dock returns the head cleanly every time — no droop, no clip wear. The body is CW617N brass, the cartridge ceramic, and the spout swivels a full 360 degrees.

name: Rivo Kitchen Mixer
blurb: A compact swivel-spout mixer in chrome for single-bowl sinks.
description:
The Rivo kitchen mixer is the straightforward one: a solid brass body, a ceramic cartridge, and a 200 mm swivel spout that clears stacked dishes without dominating the window behind it.

It shares its aerator and cartridge with the rest of the Rivo line, so spares are off the shelf. A sound choice for rentals and busy family kitchens alike.

name: Pietra Granite Composite Sink 550
blurb: A 550 mm single bowl in 80 % quartz composite — matte black, heat-proof to 230 °C.
description:
Pietra is cast from 80 % quartz bound in acrylic resin, which makes it closer to stone than to any steel sink: dead quiet under running water, warm to the touch, and resistant to scratches, staining and thermal shock to 230 °C.

The matte black runs through the full body, so a scuff shows black, not grey. It installs top-mounted or under-mounted into the same cut-out, and the template and clips are included.
